harness_notes: Each eval seeds a prior session from `files[0]` (passed via --append-system-prompt) and then sends `prompt` (with-skill, plugin loaded) or `baseline_prompt` (no plugin). The format checks (label, dash or colon, one sentence, 7 items) measure the output format this skill exists to produce; the baseline prompt doesn't ask for it, so most of this skill's delta is format compliance by design. The coverage checks measure whether the content survives the compression. Evals 5 to 9 use `session-explain.md`, whose 'Live state' section stands in for the fetches explain mode makes (the commit, the PRs and the document), since the runs have no tools beyond Skill. Eval 9 checks that a bare number stays a count even when a PR with that number exists. The jargon checks pass when a listed term is absent, or defined right where it appears.
